strings: Three parts + the coloured record + the crystal for each staff, then build under Excavation.
Snowy dig sites — spawn trenches, Excavation, Church
Gen 6 reward chest (all six generators on)
Shoot the orange plane → part lands near the mound
Inside the robots — Thor (spawn), Odin (middle), Freya (Church)
Tank Church → Gen 2: jump right after Gen 4
Tank Gen 2 → Church: jump left onto Excavation scaffolding
Tank Gen 2 → Church: jump right just before Church
Matching coloured pedestal beneath the Excavation Site
Collect the three parts for a staff (each staff hides them differently — see the staff tabs).
Find that staff's coloured record, then carry it with the Gramophone to the matching tunnel.
Play the record to open the tunnel, enter the Crazy Place, and take the matching crystal.
Build the staff on its coloured pedestal beneath the Excavation Site.
Build and upgrade the staffs as early as the run allows.
Save a zombie when you need uninterrupted time for staff puzzles or map setup.
Solve each staff puzzle, line the Excavation rings to its colour, shoot the orb, charge it in the Crazy Place.
Ice Staff code: blue-dot pillar symbols and their matching ceiling stones
Crazy Place: match blue-dot pillar → ceiling stone, shoot it
Excavation rings all BLUE → shoot the orb
Blue pedestal → kill zombies to charge
Fire Staff code: cauldron symbols and their Church torch numbers
Kill zombies on the Crazy Place grates → light 4 cauldrons
Read the symbols → shoot those numbered Church torches
Excavation rings all RED → shoot the orb
Red pedestal → kill zombies to charge
Wind Staff code: outer to inner ceiling ring symbols
Crazy Place: shoot the 4 ceiling rings to match the code
Blow all 3 chimneys' smoke toward Excavation
Excavation rings all YELLOW → shoot the orb
Yellow pedestal → kill zombies to charge
Lightning Staff piano chart: first, second and third chords
Play the 3 chords, set the 7 switches
Excavation rings all PURPLE → shoot the orb
Purple pedestal → kill zombies to charge
Solve the staff's own puzzle using its code chart (each tab shows the chart and the extra steps).
At the Excavation Site, use the four levers to align every ring to the staff's colour.
Go below the rings and shoot the orb of that colour with the staff.
Return to the Crazy Place, place the staff on its coloured pedestal, and kill zombies around it until it is fully charged.

Can't tell which lever turns which Excavation ring? Coming down toward the staff chamber, take the right-side route toward Mule Kick: that lever controls the top ring. The lever to the left of the large staircase down into the staff chamber controls the second ring. The two levers on the wooden platforms directly above Mule Kick control the bottom two rings.
Lightning: switches can be set before the piano step; once that step is active, a correct switch stops sparking. The current remembers.
Use the staff pages for full-size puzzle images instead of memorising every code.
Put each upgraded staff in its robot, and Fire in the mound pedestal.
Pedestal at the bottom of the mound
Place Wind in Odin (middle robot), Ice in Freya (church / Gen 6 robot), and Lightning in Thor (spawn / Gen 1–3 robot).
Place Fire in the pedestal at the bottom of the mound.
Fill the four soul chests in the giant robot footprints, then take One Inch Punch from the reward chest.
Fill all four soul chests in the giant robot footprints.
Collect the One Inch Punch / Thunder Fists from the reward chest.
Fill the soul chests during setup instead of leaving all four until the end.
Purify the stone tablet with melee kills in the church, bring it back without touching mud.
Do not step in mud on the way back with the tablet.
Complete the stone-tablet melee purification step in the church.
Return the tablet without stepping in mud to finish the G-Strike setup.
Have the G-Strike grenades before Rain Fire.
Press the button inside the middle robot, then G-Strike the seal by Generator 5 straight away.
Be at Generator 5 the moment you press the button — the seal must be active when the G-Strike lands.
Enter the middle robot through an open foot and press the red button.
Immediately throw a G-Strike onto the seal by Generator 5.
Have the Maxis Drone built and ready before you attempt Rain Fire — the next step needs it at once.
Send the Maxis Drone into the opened seal, then kill the Panzers that spawn.
As soon as the seal opens, send the Maxis Drone into the hole and defeat the Panzer Soldiers that spawn.
In Zombie Blood, shoot down the glowing red plane and kill the invisible pilot.
Invisible · runs clockwise · stay in Zombie Blood
Enter Zombie Blood and shoot down the glowing red plane.
Locate and kill the invisible, clockwise-running pilot while still in Zombie Blood.
No Zombie Blood from the Panzers? The Ice Staff bonfire method can produce a free one near Pack-a-Punch.
In the mound, One Inch Punch the glowing Templar zombies until the fist upgrades.
In the mound, use the One Inch Punch on the glowing / white-fist Templar zombies until the upgrade is complete, then collect the upgraded elemental fist.
All four upgraded staffs in their Crazy Place holders, then 100 kills without removing them.
The Fire Staff must be back in its Crazy Place holder before the 100 kills — and never take a staff out.
Return all four upgraded staffs to their Crazy Place holders and earn the required 100 kills without removing the staffs.
Pick up the Maxis Drone and release it into the Crazy Place beam.
Pick up the Maxis Drone, release it into the beam in the Crazy Place, and trigger the ending.
Going for the ending cutscene? Keep all generators active when you recover the upgraded Maxis Drone from the pilot sequence.
Speedrun mode unlocks once every step is marked done.
Shoot the spawn tombstones 2-3-1-4, activate all four Corruption Engines, then open Pack-a-Punch inside the Apothicon.
Nacht console, then the three yellow sacs

Shoot the four spawn tombstones in positional order (2-3-1-4). A sound cue and small fire flash confirm the code. Then activate all four Corruption Engines so the Nacht console can open the route into the Giant Apothicon.
Activate the Corruption Engines at Spawn, Der Eisendrache, Verrückt, and Mob of the Dead.
Use the Nacht der Untoten console as the Giant Apothicon passes to open the Pack-a-Punch route.
Inside the Apothicon, shoot the three yellow sacs holding Pack-a-Punch so the machine drops.
Collect the three Keeper Protector parts. Make sure the run has Little Arnies and the Apothicon Servant.

Collect the three Keeper Protector parts and make sure the run has Little Arnies plus the Apothicon Servant. Build the Keeper at Verrückt, Kino, or Der Eisendrache for 5,000 points when the ritual step is ready.
Keeper parts: gemstone, Keeper head, and flag.
Little Arnies are required for the nine-hole step.
The upgraded Apothicon Servant is required later for the bone step.
A strong Pack-a-Punched bullet weapon is useful for the bone rocks and final fight.
Hit all five blue rocks in the sky with the Apothicon Servant, then Pack-a-Punch it in the Apothicon.
Aiming the Apothicon Servant at the blue rock — Spawn
Blue rock in the sky — Spawn
Aiming the Apothicon Servant at the blue rock — Shangri-La
Blue rock in the sky — Shangri-La
Aiming the Apothicon Servant at the blue rock — Verrückt
Blue rock in the sky — Verrückt
Aiming the Apothicon Servant at the blue rock — Mob of the Dead
Blue rock in the sky — Mob of the Dead
Aiming the Apothicon Servant at the blue rock — Nacht
Blue rock in the sky — Nacht
Shoot all five blue rocks in the sky with the Apothicon Servant, then Pack-a-Punch it inside the Giant Apothicon for 5,000 points.
All five rocks must be hit with the Apothicon Servant before the weapon can be upgraded.
The Thunder Gun is optional but strongly recommended for the later Margwa phases.
Find the triangular ritual rock, bring the Keeper to it, protect it for three minutes, take the reel to Nacht’s radio.
Find the triangular ritual rock on one of the three possible jump pads, summon the Keeper Protector, and bring it close enough to begin the ritual. Protect it for three full minutes.
Triangle-rock jump pads: Shangri-La, Mob of the Dead, or Verrückt.
The Keeper starts the ritual by standing close to the triangular rock.
Protect the Keeper for three full minutes.
Pick up the dropped reel and place it in the Nacht der Untoten radio.
In the Apothicon, throw Little Arnies into all nine wall holes, never the same one twice. Kill the Margwas after each three.
Reel in the Kino stage radio
Inside the Giant Apothicon, throw Little Arnies into all nine wall holes without repeating one. Every set of three holes spawns three Margwas.
Complete three sets of three holes.
Kill the Margwas after each set; use Max Ammo or GobbleGums if you run out of Arnies.
After all nine Margwas are cleared, collect the reel from the bridge inside the Apothicon.
Place this reel in the radio on the Kino der Toten stage.
Reveal each bone with a Pack-a-Punched bullet weapon, absorb it with the upgraded Servant, then finish the body at Nacht.
Spawn: shoot it with a Pack-a-Punched bullet weapon
Shangri-La: shoot it with a Pack-a-Punched bullet weapon
Origins: shoot it with a Pack-a-Punched bullet weapon
Verrückt: shoot it with a Pack-a-Punched bullet weapon
Der Eisendrache: shoot it with a Pack-a-Punched bullet weapon
Nacht: shoot it with a Pack-a-Punched bullet weapon
Absorbing a revealed bone with the upgraded Apothicon Servant
Then absorb it with the upgraded Servant
Reel on top of the Origins mound
Reveal six hidden bones with a Pack-a-Punched bullet weapon, then absorb each bone with the upgraded Apothicon Servant. Finish the body sequence at Nacht.
Bone areas: Shangri-La, Spawn, Origins, Verrückt, Der Eisendrache, and Nacht.
After all six bones are collected, they appear on the upper floor of Nacht.
Shoot the collected bones with the upgraded Apothicon Servant, then shoot the spawned body as well.
Collect the reel and place it in the radio at the top of the Origins mound.
At each Corruption Engine, hit the blue rock behind its rift with the laser turret. Then activate S.O.P.H.I.A. at Nacht.
The turret aim can be picky; the game kicks you off when the shot registers.
Laser turret firing at the blue rock behind a rift
Use the laser turret at each Corruption Engine to hit the blue rock behind its teleporting rift. Once all four are complete, return to Nacht and activate S.O.P.H.I.A.
You need one successful turret shot from each of the four Corruption Engine areas.
After the fourth hit, activate S.O.P.H.I.A. on Nacht’s upper floor.
Get the Kronorium from Samantha’s bed, place it on the Kino altar, then hatch all four eggs in the Apothicon’s nests.
Follow S.O.P.H.I.A. to the Kino teleporter, enter Samantha’s room, collect the book from the bed, and place it on the Kino altar. Four eggs now spawn around the map.
One egg belongs to each major map region.
Take each egg into the Giant Apothicon and place it in one of the yellow incubation nests / pustules.
Kill about 10 zombies nearby to feed 10 zombie souls into the egg until it hatches into a Gateworm.
Repeat until all four eggs have become Gateworms.
Use each Gateworm to find its hidden rune. Listen for the beeping at the right spot.
Use each Gateworm to locate its hidden Rune of Creation. The correct placement is identified by a beeping sound. Collect all four runes before entering the symbol room.
Each major region has three possible rune-placement spots.
Listen for the beeping rather than guessing the placement.
After all four runes are collected, head to Kino and prepare to enter the boss arena through the projector-room rift.
All players enter together through the Kino projector room’s purple rift. Read the Kronorium, enter its symbol order, survive the Margwas.
The symbol order changes every game; read the Kronorium after entering the arena.

Have all players stand on the purple rift / circle in the Kino projector room to enter the boss arena. Interact with the Kronorium, memorize the randomized four-symbol order it shows, enter that same order at the back of the room, then survive four sets of two Margwas.
Every player must enter through the Kino projector-room purple rift / circle together.
Use the four symbols shown in your inventory/menu as the reference set.
After entering the correct sequence, drop to the center arena.
Clear four Margwa waves with two Margwas per wave to spawn the Summoning Key.
Back on the map, hit all seven targets with the Summoning Key.
When taking the teleporter toward Nacht, melee during the transition to avoid the Summoning Key-loss glitch described in the walkthrough.
Clocktower face near the Corruption Engine
Focusing Stone on the staff, top of the stairs
Tombstone at the top of the mound
Return to the map and hit all seven exact targets with the Summoning Key.
Der Eisendrache: clocktower face near the Corruption Engine.
Shangri-La: Focusing Stone / blue orb on the staff at the top of the stairs.
Origins: tombstone at the top of the mound.
Mob of the Dead: poster inside the open cell.
Verrückt: MG42 mounted on the fountain.
Charge an altar with kills, throw the Summoning Key through ghost S.O.P.H.I.A., then shoot the Shadowman into the Apothicon’s mouth.

Return through the Kino teleporter, charge one of the four altars with zombie kills, pick up the Summoning Key, throw it through the ghost of S.O.P.H.I.A., then damage the Shadowman until he is pushed into the Apothicon’s mouth.
Interact with an altar and kill roughly 10 zombies to charge it.
A powerful bullet weapon or Death Machine makes the Shadowman damage phase easier.
Throw the charged Summoning Key through ghost S.O.P.H.I.A.
Shoot the Shadowman until he is forced into the Apothicon’s mouth.
Interact with the book to trigger the ending.
Build the Dragon Shield and keep it all run — the egg and a trophy need it.
Collect one shield part from the Armory area.
Collect one shield part from the Infirmary area.
Collect the final shield part from the Operations Bunker / Department Store area.
Build the completed Guard of Fafnir at the Operations Bunker workbench.
The exact part spawn within each area is randomized. The shield is required for the egg progression and one of the silver trophies.
Power on, three Groph Module defenses, parts into the Mule Kick generator.
Turn on power at Dragon Command, complete the blue, yellow, and red code-cylinder Groph Module defenses, then install all three recovered parts in the generator by Mule Kick.
Blue cylinder → blue terminal at Dragon Command.
Yellow cylinder → yellow terminal at Supply Depot.
Red cylinder → red terminal at Tank Factory.
Follow each green Groph Module beam, defend the module with zombie kills, and collect the part after it opens.
Fly to the Hatchery / Pack-a-Punch area and survive the lockdown for Dragon Strike.
The final lockdown wave opens all four directions at once.
Call the dragon, fly to the Pack-a-Punch/Hatchery area, and survive the four-direction lockdown to claim Dragon Strike.
The final lockdown wave opens all directions at once.
Clear the zombies and Manglers, then pick up Dragon Strike from its terminal.
Warm the egg, wait one round, finish three trials, incubate it, cash it in at spawn.
Warm it in the Dragon Command nest

Shoot down the green Dragon Egg in the Hatchery, warm it in the Dragon Command nest with dragon fire or Dragon Strike, wait one round, complete the three egg trials, then incubate it in the Hatchery basement.
After the warm-up round, complete the three egg trials: napalm/dragon-fire zombie kills, single-shot penetration multi-kills, and melee kills.
Place the trial-complete egg in the Hatchery basement Incubator and charge it with zombie souls.
When the cooled egg is ready, return it to the spawn tombstone to receive the Gauntlet of Siegfried.
Warm it with dragon fire or a Dragon Strike.
Find the green-lit valve and the Master Code Cylinder, set the other five valves, take the cylinder to S.O.P.H.I.A.
Gorod Krovi map with the six valve locations marked
Find the green-lit valve and the Master Code Cylinder, use the valve solution to set the five valves, then take the released cylinder to S.O.P.H.I.A.
The green-light/cylinder combination changes, so use the dedicated Valve Solver rather than memorizing one arrangement.
Once the valves are set correctly, the cylinder releases and can be inserted at Dragon Command.
No settings? Re-check which valve is green and where the cylinder is — both change every game.
Shoot S.O.P.H.I.A.’s letter wheels to spell KRONOS, then confirm.
Widow’s Wine or Electric Cherry effects can rotate the wheels by accident.
Use bullets to rotate S.O.P.H.I.A.’s letter wheels until they spell KRONOS, then confirm the code.
Avoid accidental Widow’s Wine or Electric Cherry effects while setting the letters because they can rotate the wheels.
Collect all six, then place the set at Dragon Command.
Fafnir fireball → left window by Double Tap
Shoot it off the statue hand above the tank
Dragon Strike on the marked puddle
Fire the giant laser trap, take it from the floor
Sewer ride: shoot the red light green → toilet
Gauntlet Whelp at the safe, then punch it
Tank Factory / Double Tap: Fire the Guard of Fafnir at the left of the two windows beside Double Tap so the blast hits the pipe behind it and ejects the trophy.
Outside Dragon Command: Shoot the trophy from the raised statue hand above the tank, then collect it where it falls below.
Outside Supply Depot: Place a Dragon Strike on the marked puddle to reveal the trophy.
Supply Depot: Activate the giant laser trap and collect the trophy from the blasted floor after the trap finishes.
Pack-a-Punch / Hatchery: During the sewer ejection back toward spawn, shoot the red light until it turns green, then return to the Hatchery and collect the trophy from the toilet.
Operations Bunker safe: After earning the Gauntlet of Siegfried, release the Whelp at the locked safe, then heavy-melee/punch the safe with the Gauntlet to reveal the sixth trophy.
The safe trophy needs the Gauntlet of Siegfried — finish the egg first.
Complete each challenge the lit trophies show.
The Group 935 keycard lockdown always comes last, after the other five.
Shoot the orb until it returns to Dragon Command
Disable the terminals in the flashed order
Break the shoulder armor, walk him onto the circle
Stay with the injured Valkyrie to Dragon Command
Defend the module, Whelp brings the drop back
Keycard → Hatchery computer, survive, return it
Gersh Orb: Find the floating orb, damage it, follow its teleports, and repeat until it returns to Dragon Command.
Bomb Sequence: Watch the Dragon Command screen, memorize the flashed location order, then disable every terminal in that same order.
Mangler Escort: Find the green-eyed Mangler, break the correct shoulder armor, then walk him onto the Dragon Command circle without killing him.
Valkyrie Escort: Find the injured Valkyrie at the back of spawn and stay with it while it travels toward Dragon Command.
Groph Module Drop: Go to the location called out on screen, defend the Groph Module, then use the Gauntlet Whelp to collect its drop and return it to S.O.P.H.I.A.
Group 935 Challenge: Take the keycard to the Hatchery computer, survive the Mangler lockdown while the download completes, retrieve the keycard, and return it to S.O.P.H.I.A.
Gersh Orb: The Pack-a-Punched Ray Gun Mark 3 makes the repeated damage windows much easier.
Bomb Sequence: Write or screenshot the sequence before leaving Dragon Command if needed.
Mangler Escort: Use a normal un-Pack-a-Punched bullet weapon for the shoulder shot and keep stray bullets away from the Mangler afterward.
Valkyrie Escort: Avoid Widow’s Wine and Electric Cherry effects near the drone because accidental damage can fail the challenge.
Groph Module Drop: The called-out module can be at Dragon Command, Tank Factory, or Supply Depot.
Take the Power Core, send it to Nikolai with the Gauntlet Whelp at spawn, then enter the boss route.
After the Group 935 challenge, collect S.O.P.H.I.A.’s Power Core, use the Gauntlet Whelp at spawn to deliver the core to Nikolai, return to S.O.P.H.I.A., and enter the newly opened boss-fight route.
Before entering, bring strong perks, a Pack-a-Punched Ray Gun Mark 3 if available, a fresh shield, and In Plain Sight if you have it.
Hit each weak point Nikolai exposes as the dragon lands, with the Ray Gun Mark 3.
Use the shield to protect yourself from the dragon’s fire.
Ray Gun Mark 3 on the wound
In the first boss phase, let Nikolai expose each dragon weak point as it lands, then damage the wounded areas with the Ray Gun Mark 3.
Repeat the weak-point cycle across the dragon’s landing positions until the dragon dies.
After the final weak point is destroyed, the dragon dies and the Nikolai phase begins.
In Plain Sight, break the mech weak points, then finish the center.
Trigger In Plain Sight, destroy Nikolai’s exposed mech weak points with the Ray Gun Mark 3, then finish the center once it opens.
Focus the lit mech sections and upper left/right weak points first.
Once those are destroyed, the middle opens for the finishing damage.
Feed all three dragons, then take the base bow from the Family Crypt.
Courtyard — above the Double Tap tunnel
Mission Control — fireplace by Speed Cola
Family Crypt / Knight’s Tomb, above the Undercroft
Feed the Courtyard dragon: Kill eight zombies one at a time beneath the dragon above the tunnel near Double Tap. Wait for each eating animation before making the next kill.
Feed the Mission Control dragon: Repeat the eight single-feed kills at the dragon in the fireplace / Mission Control area by Speed Cola.
Feed the Undercroft dragon: Repeat the process at the dragon in the Pyramid / Undercroft. The head crumbles when it is completely fed.
Claim the bow: After all three dragons crumble, go to the Family Crypt / Knight’s Tomb room above the Undercroft and take the Wrath of the Ancients from the altar.
A dragon only accepts one corpse at a time.
Start feeding dragons while opening the map so the base bow is ready early.
The old guide was wrong: you do NOT collect arrows from the dragon throats and you do NOT place three arrows into the Pyramid.
Ranked / online: one upgraded bow per player. Local / offline or unranked: all four bows.
Weather vane at the Bastion / Death Ray
Above Double Tap by the workbench
Do the low-gravity wall run before the room gets crowded.
A missed bonfire shot normally means recharging from the matching urn.
Red symbol at the top of the Clock Tower spiral stairs
Four shots total to land the rock in the fireplace.
Route the flame to the fireplace
The fireplace route allows four total shots — plan the landing points before firing.
Four story paintings around the castle
The painting positions can vary; the story order does not.
Keep the last zombie controlled before the anti-gravity wall shot.
Purple glyph above the Gate Trap / Double Tap side
Write the Keeper’s three-word name down immediately.
Do not guess the rune order — a mistake wastes more time than checking the translation.
Every path ends the same way: place the reforged arrow in that bow’s altar around the Pyramid, feed it zombie souls, insert the Wrath of the Ancients, and collect the upgraded bow.
Finish the required upgrade before starting the wisp cycle — the wisps are shot with an upgraded bow.
Only tick the bows you need; mark the step done when your lobby’s requirement is met.
Build as you go — every player needs a Ragnarok DG-4 before the boss.
Activate the Death Ray at least once before the quest reaches the fuse and safe sequence.
Death Ray on → Wundersphere to the part above the Bastion
Arm the stair switch, survive the bunker, green teleporter console
Church · Gatehouse above Double Tap · Undercroft

Ragnarok parts: kill the first Panzersoldat; activate the Death Ray and use the correct Wundersphere route to catch the part floating above the Bastion; during a Rocket Test, arm the stair switch, survive in the bunker, then use the green teleporter console.
Build the Ragnaroks at a workbench. Every player needs one before the boss-entry tiles.
Shield parts sit in three zones (Lower Courtyard / Gate Trap, Clock Tower / Mission Control, Undercroft anti-gravity). Build it early.
Stand on all four Pyramid floor plates so anti-gravity cycles become available, and move the three Pack-a-Punch teleporter pieces into position early.
Prime the teleporter, hit four wisps, travel to the past together.
Use the BASE Wrath of the Ancients on the six teleporter prongs. The wisps themselves are shot with an upgraded bow.
Spawn / Quick Revive — phone on the table
Spawn → Double Tap — broken car front wheel
Mission Control — clock near the dragon
Courtyard → Clock Tower route — clock upstairs
Prime all six teleporter prongs: At the teleporter, shoot the six electrical prongs above it with the base bow until they glow orange/gold and the audio cue plays.

Shoot four wisps: One wisp is active at a time across eight possible objects. Find and shoot four with an upgraded bow before the timer expires. The teleporter turns purple when the cycle is complete.
Travel together: All players enter the purple teleporter together. Inside the past laboratory, move quickly before the return sequence begins.
Only one wisp is active at a time, and it moves after every hit.
If the cycle fails, wait for the next round and prime the teleporter again.
Past lab: canister, fuses, safe code
Grab the blue Soul Canister and the small fuses, and record the three safe symbols.
The safe code changes every game — record it before you are sent back.
Take the Soul Canister and fuses: Pick up the blue Soul Canister and the small fuses. You will use them later at the Moon Pyramid Device and Death Ray.
Memorize the safe code: Read Dr. Groph’s three safe symbols from top to bottom. The combination changes between games, so record it before leaving.
Fuses into the Death Ray, enter the safe code, loot the safe, power the pylons.
Kill the returning Panzer: A Panzersoldat appears after the first trip. Kill it, then continue setting up the Death Ray.
Install the fuses and set Protect: Insert the small fuses into the Death Ray panel on the Clock Tower side and flip the Death Ray lever to Protect.
Enter the safe code: Use the Clock Tower terminal to enter the three symbols you memorized in the past. A correct entry opens the safe in the teleporter room.
Loot the safe: Collect the two large Tesla coils/fuses and the key card/floppy-style quest item from the opened safe.
Install the large coils: Place the two large coils into the Death Ray pylons, switch the system back to Destroy, and use the key card at the terminal.
Solve both memory terminals, crash Dempsey’s pod, take the Vril Generator.
TAKE THE VRIL GENERATOR from the crashed pod — the game does not make the pickup obvious.
Complete both Simon Says terminals: Repeat the flashing symbol sequence at the Clock Tower terminal and again at the Rocket Platform terminal. Hellhounds may pressure you while the puzzle is active.
Bring Dempsey’s pod down: Press the green Death Ray button after both terminals are solved. The rocket/pod crashes into the courtyard.
TAKE THE VRIL GENERATOR: Pick up the Vril Generator / Golden Rod from the crashed pod wreckage. It is easy to miss because the game does not make this pickup obvious.
Hellhounds may pressure you while a Simon Says puzzle is active.
Repeat the wisps, go back to the past, take the Keeper Stone.
Prime the teleporter again: Repeat the six-prong activation and complete another four-wisp cycle. The eight possible wisp objects are the same as the first cycle.
Return to the past laboratory: Take the purple teleporter again with all players present.
Open the Keeper Stone case: Use the quest computer/key-card interaction in the past to open the case, then collect the Keeper Stone / tablet before returning.
Summon the Keeper, follow it to four circles, charge each with the bow it asks for.
Vril Generator → Family Crypt knight socket
Kill with the bow colour shown
The colour at the edge of your screen while standing in the circle
Insert the Keeper Stone into the wall / lamppost slot
Summon the Keeper: Place the Vril Generator into the socket beneath the resting knight in the Family Crypt. A ghostly Keeper appears and begins moving through the map.

Follow it to each ritual circle: The Keeper stops at four locations around the castle. Stand inside the white circle and watch the edge of the screen for the color that identifies the required upgraded bow.
Feed each circle with bow kills: While a player stands in the circle, kill zombies with the requested upgraded bow. The zombies do not need to be standing inside the circle themselves.
Place the Keeper Stone at Double Tap: At the Double Tap ritual location, insert the Keeper Stone into its wall/lamppost slot so the ritual can continue.
Finish all four locations: When the final site is charged, the Keeper becomes solid and returns to the Undercroft / Moon Pyramid Device.
Zombies do not need to be standing inside the circle — only the player does.
Soul Canister into the MPD, every player ready, then plant Ragnaroks together.
No return: planting the Ragnaroks on the pyramid tiles starts the boss fight.
Insert the Soul Canister: Place the blue Soul Canister from the first time-travel trip into the empty corner of the Moon Pyramid Device.
Finish every Ragnarok DG-4: Every player needs a completed Ragnarok DG-4 before entering the boss fight. Use the Gear page if a part is still missing.
Gear up before entry: Buy perks, refill ammo, repair shields, and make sure your upgraded bow is ready. Once everyone plants Ragnaroks on the pyramid tiles, the fight begins.
Plant the Ragnaroks together: Each player places a Ragnarok on a separate anti-gravity / pyramid tile to trigger the teleport into the Keeper boss arena.
Three Keeper damage phases with Panzer waves between. Stun with a Ragnarok, shoot the chest.
Missed the stun? Get behind a blue pillar before the shockwave.
Keeper Damage Phase: Watch for the electrical orb beneath the Keeper in the center. Plant a Ragnarok into the orb / directly beneath the Keeper to stun it, then unload into the glowing open chest.
Panzer & Skeleton Wave: Clear the Panzers and skeletons while recharging the Ragnaroks. Use the Max Ammo from the transition to reset before the next damage phase.
Second Keeper Damage Phase: Repeat the Ragnarok stun and chest damage. Hellhounds begin adding pressure, so keep the arena controlled instead of tunnel-visioning the Keeper.
Second Panzer Wave: Clear the next Panzer wave, refill the Ragnaroks again, and prepare for the final Keeper cycle.
Final Keeper Damage Phase: Land the third successful Ragnarok stun and finish the glowing chest. In co-op, be ready for extra enemies during the final damage window.
Recharge the Ragnaroks during every Panzer wave.
Hellhounds join from the second damage phase; keep the arena controlled.
Take the Summoning Key from the MPD to the Clock Tower terminal.
After the Keeper dies, return to the Moon Pyramid Device and collect the Summoning Key when it becomes available.
Carry the Summoning Key to the terminal outside the Clock Tower — the same general terminal area used during the safe / memory sequence.

Install all three cogs, put on a fresh gas mask, then descend to the boss arena.

Masamune the vine spores, keep moving, and damage the boss whenever its weak point opens.

The fight repeats across several damage cycles; prioritize movement and gas-mask survival.
Complete the final damage phase to finish Seeds of Doubt and trigger the ending sequence.
In Beast Mode, open each ritual room and item, finish the ritual, take its Gateworm. Note the train symbols on the way.
Junction / Nero: open the truck box, collect the Summoning Key and pen, then complete the ritual in Nero’s room.
Canals / Ruby Rabbit: expose the police badge, open the ritual room, complete the ritual, and collect the Gateworm.
Ride Waterfront → Footlight and record the first two train symbols; they change every game.

Charge the egg with zombie souls at four statues: underground rift, Footlight, Waterfront, and Canals.

Place all four Gateworms and the Summoning Key in the underground ritual room, then survive until it ends.

Place the Summoning Key on the center ritual table.
Survive for roughly 30 seconds until the ritual completes.

Get your Arch-Ovum from your Keeper, then finish one Margwa challenge per round at all four spots.
Only one of these locations can be completed per round.
Place the Arch-Ovum outside a ritual area and kill the Margwa that spawns.

Raise the book in Nero’s room, take the flag underground, defend it at each district’s placements, deliver it to that ritual table.
If the flag takes too much damage it breaks and the attempt must be repeated.
The walkthrough starts in Canals: defend the first electrified placement for about 30 seconds, pick up the charged flag, then defend the second Canals placement.
Meatballs attack the flag and the Shadowman appears; shoot the Shadowman away whenever he stays in the map too long.
After the district placements, bring the flag to that district’s ritual table.
Repeat the process on later rounds for Waterfront, Footlight, and finally Junction.
In co-op, have everyone move away from the flag before the carrier tries to pick it up.
Activate the Keeper(s), shoot the Shadowman over the ritual table, then trap him in the Summoning Key.
If you are holding a Death Machine, put it away before interacting with the table or the interaction will not work.
A Death Machine or another strong high-rate-of-fire weapon makes the damage phase much easier.
Keep shooting until the Shadowman is pushed over the ritual table.
Interact with the table to trap him inside the Summoning Key.
